grammar.composition_primitive: One edge-to-edge landscape frame; centered brand/proposition overlay; fixed-height lower news strip follows the media; persistent compact top navigation.
grammar.visual_hierarchy: Brand wordmark small; proposition centered at medium relative scale; thin white type over darker region; secondary text smaller; top nav compact.
grammar.typography_observation: Brand wordmark small; proposition centered at medium relative scale; thin white type over darker region; secondary text smaller; top nav compact.
grammar.media_observation: Wide garden photograph as the dominant canvas; crop preserves landscape and water as the focal field; overlaid text remains within the image; no asset-layer inference beyond observed render.
grammar.spatial_rhythm: Large uninterrupted image scene followed by narrow information strip; surrounding viewport density low.
grammar.responsive_recomposition: Hero changes to narrow portrait crop; proposition remains over media at smaller scale; compact header; news strip remains as next band.
grammar.implementation_boundary: DOM: logo, proposition, navigation, news strip, links. Image asset: landscape photograph with responsive object-position variants. CSS: overlay and contrast gradient only if needed for verified contrast; no text baked into image.
misuse_constraints: Requires licensed high-resolution environment photography with a quiet text-safe area.
Do not place text over busy focal details without an independently tested contrast treatment.
Short proposition copy preferred; mobile crop must preserve focal subject and text zone.

grammar.composition_primitive: Compact institutional header and primary blue navigation; below it, an asymmetric multi-column first layer with a large announcement/hero panel, search/task controls, news list, and supporting modules.
grammar.visual_hierarchy: Small high-density navigation; task labels and news headlines use restrained hierarchy; blue bar separates primary navigation from content.
grammar.typography_observation: Small high-density navigation; task labels and news headlines use restrained hierarchy; blue bar separates primary navigation from content.
grammar.media_observation: Official announcement image in one bounded feature panel; secondary modules rely mostly on text and small visual tiles.
grammar.spatial_rhythm: Dense, highly grouped utility modules; repeated horizontal rules/colored containers separate functions.
grammar.responsive_recomposition: Primary nav compresses to compact top controls; multi-column groups stack vertically; search/task block moves near top; informational items retain boxed grouping.
grammar.implementation_boundary: DOM: nav landmarks, search/links, announcement, lists, headings. CSS Grid for desktop; one-column DOM order matching task priority on mobile. Image assets remain decorative only where text duplicates content.
misuse_constraints: Task priority must be supported by user research/official service obligations; do not copy source order blindly.
Dense layouts require responsive spacing, visible focus and legible line lengths.
Accessibility runtime was not tested; this record makes no accessibility pass claim.
